name: @activepieces/piece-recurly
description: Manage subscriptions, billing accounts, and recurring revenue with Recurly.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Developer Settings](https://app.recurly.com/go/developer/api_keys).

create_account.name: create_account
create_account.description: Create a billing account in Recurly.

code.description: A unique account code for this customer, for example acme-123.

email.description: The primary email address for the billing account.

company.description: The company name for this billing account.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new billing account in Recurly to represent a customer, identified by a unique account code you supply. Use before creating subscriptions, since a subscription must be attached to an existing account. Not idempotent: each call attempts to create a new account, and reusing an account code that already exists will fail.

create_subscription.name: create_subscription
create_subscription.description: Start a new subscription for an existing Recurly account.

accountCode.description: Select the account that should own the subscription.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Developer Settings](https://app.recurly.com/go/developer/api_keys).

planCode.description: Select the plan for the new subscription.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Developer Settings](https://app.recurly.com/go/developer/api_keys).

currency.description: The 3-letter ISO currency code to bill in, for example USD.

quantity.description: The subscription quantity. Leave at 1 for standard subscriptions.

aiMetadata.description: Starts a new recurring subscription on a given plan for an existing Recurly account, billing in the specified currency. Use to begin charging a customer; the account and plan must already exist (referenced by their codes). Not idempotent: each call creates and begins billing a separate subscription.

get_account.name: get_account
get_account.description: Retrieve details for a billing account in Recurly.

accountCode.description: Select the account you want to retrieve.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Developer Settings](https://app.recurly.com/go/developer/api_keys).

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full details of a single Recurly billing account by its account code. Use to look up a customer record or confirm an account exists before acting on it. Read-only and idempotent.

list_subscriptions.name: list_subscriptions
list_subscriptions.description: Browse subscriptions in Recurly, with an option to filter by account and state.

accountCode.description: Optionally select an account to list only that account’s subscriptions.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Developer Settings](https://app.recurly.com/go/developer/api_keys).

limit.description: The maximum number of subscriptions to return.

aiMetadata.description: Lists subscriptions in Recurly, optionally scoped to a single account and/or filtered by state (active, canceled, expired, future, paused, or all when state is left empty). Use to find subscriptions or check what a customer is subscribed to; leaving the account code empty lists across all accounts. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Developer Settings](https://app.recurly.com/go/developer/api_keys).

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: You can obtain API key from [Developer Settings](https://app.recurly.com/go/developer/api_keys).

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
